STAMFORD, Conn.


, Nov. 18, 2026


/PRNewswire/ — Tronox Holdings plc (NYSE: TROX) (“Tronox” or the “Company”), the world’s leading integrated manufacturer of titanium dioxide (“TiO2“) pigment, today issued a Company update in response to a November 17, 2026 article in *The Wall Street Journal* reporting that two groups of Tronox creditors had engaged with law firms who the article labelled as “restructuring advisors”. The Company understands that these creditor engagements were formed last year, and according to the article, one such engagement was recently reinstated.


Tronox has at no time engaged with either of these creditor groups or their advisors. The decision, some time ago, by these two groups to retain law firms does not signal that negotiations with Tronox are imminent or even likely.


The Company remains well positioned with ample liquidity. As discussed in the Company’s third quarter earnings release, related earnings presentation, and Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q, available liquidity at the end of the quarter ending September 30, 2026 totaled $509 million, including $136 million in cash and cash equivalents and $373 million available under revolving credit agreements. The next significant debt maturity for the Company is not until 2029. Tronox does not have any financial covenants on its term loans or bonds. The Company has additional levers to enhance liquidity, if needed. The Company does not expect to trigger the springing covenant on the US revolving credit facility. The Company will continue to review and consider opportunities to bolster liquidity, extend maturities, reduce or refinance its debt or take other appropriate actions.


Chief Executive Officer John D. Romano commented, “We are confident we have ample liquidity to operate the business and remain current on all our obligations. Running our assets safely and reliably, reducing costs, and serving our customers remain our top priorities.”


**About Tronox**


Tronox Holdings plc is one of the world’s leading producers of high-quality titanium products, including titanium dioxide pigment, specialty-grade titanium dioxide products and high-purity titanium chemicals, and zircon. We mine titanium-bearing mineral sands and operate upgrading facilities that produce high-grade titanium feedstock materials, pig iron and other minerals, including the rare earth-bearing mineral, monazite. With approximately 5,700 employees across six continents, our rich diversity, unmatched vertical integration model, and unparalleled operational and technical expertise across the value chain, position Tronox as the preeminent titanium dioxide producer in the world. For more information about how our products add brightness and durability to paints, plastics, paper and other everyday products, visit[tronox.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4826543-1&h=1765318365&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tronox.com%2F&a=tronox.com) .
